move: serif letters bounce in, banana spins through and parks, letters shove aside
how: A yellow stage with a large faint ring, the word RIPE split into serif characters, an SVG banana and two masked tags. Letters drop from yPercent -160 with random tilt (bounce.out, 0.9s, 0.1s stagger) and the ring scales in. At 9% the banana flies from x -1100 rotating -540 to the centre (move, 1.4s); at 15% the letters shove xPercent +/-34 from the centre (expo.out) and settle to +/-26 with elastic.out(1,0.5). From 23% to 87% the banana turns 720deg (power1.inOut) while bobbing y -22 (sine.inOut yoyo) and the ring turns 180. At 89% the banana flicks out to x 1200 with an extra spin (expo.in), the letters close back and drop yPercent 160 (power3.in), tags fly up and the ring fades. Timeline duration is 10s.
adapt: Change the word (letters shove by index relative to the middle), the SVG fruit, colours and tags; keep the bounce.out drop, the 1.4s fly-in and the elastic shove.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the ring, letters, fruit SVG and tags; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with fly-in at 0.09D, shove 0.155D, spin 0.23D to 0.87D, exit 0.89D. fx.rng(7) becomes a seeded rng in mount; scope selectors to el.
caveats: the letters exit by yPercent 160 without a mask, so they simply drop below the frame
